# ViewportFrame

- Inherits [`UIObject`](uiobject.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ViewportFrame")`

A UI object that draws the parts and models parented inside it: an item turning in an inventory slot, a character preview or a 3D icon. Its contents are drawn only here and are not simulated. There is no physics and no collision, so move them from a script by setting `CFrame`.

It is drawn again only when something inside it, its camera or its size changes, so forty still items cost forty pictures once. It is lit by a simple light of its own, with no sky. With `BackgroundTransparency` at 1, only the instances show. It also works inside a `SurfaceGui`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ambient` | `Color3` | `Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)` | read/write | The color of the light that reaches the contents from every direction. |
| `CurrentCamera` | `Camera?` | — | read/write | A `Camera` inside the frame to look through. With nil, the frame's contents are framed automatically, from the front and slightly above. |
| `LightColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The color of the frame's directional light. |
| `LightDirection` | `vector` | `vector.create(-1, -1, -1)` | read/write | The direction in which the frame's directional light travels. By default it points down and away from the viewer. |
